articles.title: RBI likely to keep rates unchanged in August as inflation risks persist
articles.description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is expected to keep the benchmark repo rate unchanged in its August monetary policy review on elevated inflation risks and pending the closure of the FCNR(B) deposit scheme, a poll of 10 economists and treasury heads has revealed. Economists said the central bank will remain in a "wait-and-watch" mode as it assesses the evolving inflation outlook. "As of now, trimmed core inflation remains benign and suggests a status quo is the best policy option for the time being, with caution being expressed through the policy tone," said Aditi Nayar, chief economist at ICRA.
